name: Excalidraw Diagram

Triggers on "Excalidraw", "画图", "流程图", "思维导图", "可视化", "diagram", "标准Excalidraw", "standard excalidraw", "Excalidraw动画", "动画图", "animate".

name: Mermaid Visualizer
summary: Transform text content into professional Mermaid diagrams for presentations and documentation. Use when users ask to visualize concepts, create flowcharts, or make diagrams from text. name: Obsidian Canvas Creator
summary: Create Obsidian Canvas files from text content, supporting both MindMap and freeform layouts. Use this skill when users want to visualize content as an interactive canvas, create mind maps, or organize information spatially in Obsidian format.
